flint-and-steel.name: Flint and Steel
flint-and-steel.blurb:
Sinzer, Mary, and Doron live peacefully in a small crossroads town until fire, fear and blood force them to run and warn others.

As the journey brings them face to face with monstrous briarborn, magical mosswives, and the sweet music of oblivion,  they must face their own lies.

Mary tells herself if she can just told tight enough, she won’t lose anyone else. Doron tells himself he can leave behind who he was before, that he can escape his life as a killer. Sinzer tells himself if he was just a little better, he could save everyone. They are all wrong.

A deadly gamble goes awry, separating the group. Pushed to the brink, they each must make a choice.

To fail is to lose their life, their love, or their soul.
